sloka: पर्वताग्रं समुत्क्षिप्य समाविध्य महाकपिः।अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ।। ६.६७.५३ ।।
transliteration: parvatāgraṁ samutkṣipya samāvidhya mahākapiḥ।abhidudrāva vegena kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam ।। 6.67.53 ।।

translations.english: Valiant Sugriva, seeing the mighty Kumbhakarna coming towards him jumped (in excitement).
